subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Living things do not always ask loudly for help.”?
options: Sometimes it takes visitors to make people notice what they already have.
Sometimes they only wait quietly for someone to notice.
Sometimes it lives quietly in families, waiting for someone young to carry it forward.
Sometimes it works best when people barely notice it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it takes visitors to make people notice what they already have.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Living things do not always ask loudly for help. Sometimes they only wait quietly for someone to notice.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it lives quietly in families, waiting for someone young to carry it forward.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Sometimes it works best when people barely notice it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Living things do not always ask loudly for help. Sometimes they only wait quietly for someone to notice.」，答案為「Sometimes they only wait quietly for someone to notice.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Sometimes they only wait quietly for someone to notice.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
